calls.statement:
SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15' 
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
  AND channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as min_date,
  MAX(sale_date) as max_date
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
  channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15' 
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY channel_code

SELECT 
  channel_id,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15'

GROUP BY channel_id
ORDER BY channel_id

SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15' 
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
  AND channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  sale_date,
  channel_id,
  dc.channel_name,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
LEFT JOIN dim_channel dc ON fsl.channel_id = dc.channel_id
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15' 
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
  AND fsl.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY sale_date, channel_id, dc.channel_name
ORDER BY sale_date, channel_id
